# AltText.ai

AltText.ai is a service that automatically generates alt text for images, enhancing accessibility and SEO.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/alttext-ai/.

## Actions

- **Get Account** (read-only): Retrieve account settings and usage information.
- **Get Account** (read-only): Retrieve account settings and usage information.
- **Get Images** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of images in your library, including their alt text and metadata.
- **Search Images** (read-only): Search for images and their alt text.
- **Update Account**: Update account settings (e.g., webhook url, name).
